notes.title: Fandom Update
notes.content:
We are proud to announce our first pass on FANDOM!  Fandom is a global leaderboard, where your rank is determined by the number of "fans" you have.  Fans are earned by playing matches.  The better you perform, the more fans you get!

Have a large fandom has some major perks, such as higher quality loot, and substantially increased voxel earnings!

However, fans are fickle beasts.  They come and go.  If you ignore them, they will leave, but if you play consistently, they will flock to you, particularly on weekends!

Related to the feeling of glory, your auto-generated GIFs are now also automatically published onto Twitter via our [url=https://twitter.com/Forging_Glory]Forging Glory bot[/url], unless disabled in options!  From there, we retweet the best ones from our official ZoopTEK account!

This update also comes with a heap of other changes:

Loot:
[list][*]Added item quality, which represents how well balanced an item's positive modifiers compare to their negatives.  Historically, all items were as close to 100% quality as possible.  Now it's possible to get very bad items, however this gives new players a better sense of progression.  Crafted items always aim for 100% quality, for now.[/list]

Scoring:
[list][*]Respawn time becomes a factor if your team is way ahead of the enemy's, except in Duel.  Maximum of 30 seconds.  Stay alive to maximize your glory!
[*]Increased glory on knocking enemies off the arena.
[*]Increased glory for repelling pistol projectiles.
[*]Increased glory for hitting someone with a repelled pistol projectile.
[*]Increased glory for blocking a projectile without a shield.
[*]Reduced cost of most unlocks by 50%.  This means you can roughly unlock two unlocks per victory.
[*]Losing team now earns even more glory the further they are behind.  You guys are just too good at the game![/list]

Aesthetics:
[list][*]New item user interface!
[*]Rebalanced brightness of avatars and environments.  Focused on making the avatars and their weapons the brightest compared to everything else.
[*]Reduced sword trail opacity.
[*]Goals now have glowy boxes representing the official boundaries for flag delivery.  Only visible when a player has the flag.
[*]Added fancy reflections to most surfaces!  Pretty!  Thanks DigDog![/list]

AI:
[list][*]Non-bosses are now have obvious roles, such as "Stunner" and "Sniper."  Their names now reflect these roles.
[*]AI now use traits!  Some intelligently!
[*]When an AI tries to block an attack, they will sometimes retarget to the attacker.
[*]Improved AI pathfinding some.  Less jittering.
[*]AI can now back up.[/list]

Ammunition:
[list][*]It now costs energy to begin loading a projectile.  That cost is displayed on projectile weapons.
[*]No longer costs energy throughout the projectile loading.  However, the bow will consume additional energy if it is held for a long time.[/list]

Fixes:
[list][*]Match results are a lot quicker to load.  (Known issue: some past matches incorrectly show win state.  Don't worry, this can be fixed.)
[*]Fixed bug with some platforms having no spawn points, which meant some maps could have no spawn points.
[*]Spawn points and flags are now properly grounded.
[*]Potentially fixed bug where you could double-spawn, making a ghost of yourself.
[*]Reduced likelihood of failing to connect.
[*]Potentially fixed bug for "moving for X second" traits.[/list]

(Originally published July 4, 2020.)

notes.title: New Player Experience + Quality of Life
notes.content:
Thanks to diligent feedback from new beta players, and suggestions from our veterans, we have released a big update improving everyone's experience, no matter where they are in the progression!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YBmNJUd.gif[/img]

[h2]New Player Experience[/h2]
About a month ago we had an influx of new players, which provided tons of helpful feedback on how to smooth out their experience.

All new players are now given two starting avatars: a dual pistoleer for rapid-fire ranged combat, and a spear and shield avatar for stabby melee combat. This should give brand new players to find an avatar immediately that more closely fits their play style, or better fits the combat situation. Also, dual pistols provides increased firepower over the original starting avatar, with a single pistol.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UyDCp5S.gif[/img]

To give new players more flexibility and strategic options, we have made all item types available to unlock in any order. Fancy yourself an archer? Go head, unlock it first.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mmaexNc.png[/img]

Similarly, account upgrades, such as the voxel shop (buy items) and voxel smith (crafting) are now available through unlocks; previously you had to complete campaigns to earn them.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uCqASPX.gif[/img]

One of the first things players ask is "how do I move faster?" We have now integrated the answer to that question in our tutorial, by giving all new players the sprint trait immediately, instead of requiring an unlock. Similarly, we have made the movement speed modifier immediately available to unlock. Doctore, the trainer of gladiators, will even reward you for using your newfound speed with a pile of voxels.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aiwYdQ5.png[/img]

Of course, as with all games nowadays, some omniscient voice needs to explain everything to new players, and for us that comes in the form of Doctore. We have added sixty new phrases to Doctore, finally teaching players how to aim their swing and how to block.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/z85usDT.gif[/img]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
We didn't forget about the veteran players either, with a boat load of quality of life changes. First and foremost, the ability to add new campaigns at any time, but at a cost, to incentivize finishing existing campaigns.

We have also added a bunch of sliders to options for controlling various graphical settings, audio volumes, and controls! Although we had basic options like graphics quality before, these expanded options will allow players to customize their experience precisely, down to the decibel!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8OuQVkH.png[/img]

One thing that has plagued newcomers and veterans alike is an issue that reduced spear and one hand sword damage. Those have now been buffed, and should be equatable to other weapons available in the roster!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/doatKO5.gif[/img]

Players frequently found aiming push and shield bash difficult, especially in higher latency matches. We have greatly increased push and shield bash "size" to facilitate aiming. You can push bosses off ledges like never before!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KIgW1Qb.gif[/img]

In a similar vein, we have now significantly boosted glory (point) earnings for various actions, such as fighting in melee against a stronger opponent, and knocking opponents off the arena, as seen above!

Some of our veteran players may not like this improvement much, haha, but we have made the AI a bit more aggressive against rangers. No longer can you snipe without punishment!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aLkAuCK.gif[/img]

Last but not least, we worked a lot on smoothing out various networking issues. The game will now attempt to reconnect if a player is disconnected as they join a match, and avatars will no longer "vibrate" around when joining mid-match.

But most importantly, knocked down avatars are now correctly synchronized, so you no longer miss when attempting to hit avatars on the floor! How embarrassing to miss a knocked out target!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/baZlKtB.gif[/img]

Are you ready to join the ranks of gladiators? We are always looking for new beta players! [url=https://discord.gg/AMTKx9R]Join our Discord and ask for a key![/url]

Not brave enough for beta? No problem! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/451790/Forging_Glory/]Wishlist on Steam![/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/451790/Forging_Glory/][img]https://i.imgur.com/a39XL2Q.png[/img][/url]

Full patch notes are listed below!

Both are automatically equipped with sprint.(Thanks Fllad, ClassicDeems, and JBelay!)[/*][*]All new players now have spear, shield, sprint, and headshot damage unlocked.[/*][*]All item types are now immediately available to unlock, in any order, giving new players more flexibility in what to focus on first. notes.title: Progression 2.0 + Aesthetics Updates!
notes.content:
(Published April 29, 2020)

After over a month of effort, and diligent feedback from our players, we have a very exciting update, Progression 2.0 AND Aesthetics!

The unlocks system now provides what the game needed most: direction. Although tutorials, quests, and campaigns, got players in the game, many felt lost when it came to how to best upgrade their avatars. Fascinatingly enough, many players simply didn't know what tools were available for upgrading their gladiators!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929473/cc2e84bd159f6eab0084159cd1bca199571a49f5.jpg[/img]

The new unlocks page now acts as the centralized hub for expanding the player's capabilities. It gives a sky-high view of how much of the game's modifiers, traits, skins, and more they have yet to unlock. For each unlockable, it has a short description, and a detailed description with numeric and visual examples. Also, unlocking now grants you an item with that new modifier, trait, skin, etc so the player can try it out immediately! Neat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929473/20529e03a7974948ec1d882d982afdd31a1a5696.png[/img]

The unlocks page will even list out unlocks that are in your inventory or campaign! No more forgetting about those beloved voxel shop slots or even more importantly, the voxel smith itself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929473/76788dc5735b7032e0063d549defbe1039c02629.jpg[/img]

In our follow-up patch, we also greatly polished the game's aesthetic! Rebalancing post effects, contrast, adding motion blur, overhauling nearly all particle effects, and adding background props like a jumbotron and stadium lights, all of which greatly enhance the cinematic feel of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929473/8d0f796a3d1178cd7803b4192ec853e437b1d084.gif[/img]

It may seem small, but trust us, it makes a world of difference, and the players agree! It feels like a new game!

notes.title: Bugicide Update
notes.content:
Last night we released another patch, which provided some substantial performance improvements and other bug fixes! At this point, we're just making up silly titles for these more bug-fix-oriented patches, haha.
[h1]Gameplay:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929473/8ae57e1cb282c71cce37c30bbd9e249b2cc3e55a.png[/img]
[list][*] When a team loses an arena on a campaign map, they will "reinforce" another arena. This means difficulty will increase as you slowly wipe an enemy team off the map.
[*] Fortification is now more clearly labeled as Difficulty on the campaign map.
[*] Mouse and movement controls now use smooth delta time, meaning framerate jumps shouldn't be as catastrophic.
[*] GREATLY decreased CPU and GPU load, which helps action fluidity immensely. (Browser was eating a lot of cycles despite being closed.)
[*] Active matches on campaign map now show which teams are involved.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36929473/630083b3f6f814fc73a2c1fe87c64823c2992caa.gif[/img]
[list][*] Fixed a potential crash when joining a match mid-game.
[*] Fixed score desync between client and and server.
[*] Procedurally generated skyboxes have been disabled, at least for now, in an attempt to attempt to discover a potential texture memory leak.
[*] EULA text is back.
[*] Bandwidth warning threshold tweaked.
[/list]
[h1]Technobabble:[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/a92yoIj.png[/img]
[list][*] Fixed URL bug that prevented linked GIFs from being posted into Discord. This pretty much resolves all known GIF issues.
[*] Threaded completion events now occur on the correct thread. This should fix a myriad of "random" bugs, such as server crashes while joining mid-match.
[*] Norton Security warning window will no longer cause an exception.
[*] Consolidated .NET Framework usage to .NET 4.7.2.
[*] .NET Framework 4.7.2 now installed via Steam.
[/list]
If you're interested in participating in Forging Glory's beta, please [url=https://discord.gg/AMTKx9R]join our Discord and request a key[/url]!

notes.content:
Today, we fixed a myriad of small issues that our beta testers have encountered the last two weeks.[list]
[*]Explosion trait results were ignoring their range!  Yikes!
[*]New accounts now fetch their Steam names, instead of relying on a second login.
[*]Weapons with elemental damage were not showing their effects.
[*]Replaced the infamous "slurp" sound associated with life leach with a pleasing choral hum :-).

notes.title: Stepping into the Limelight
notes.content:
[h2]What Happened?[/h2]
We've been working on Forging Glory, what is effectively a looter shooter, except with physics-based swords, for over 4 years. It has been a project built upon blood, sweat, and sometimes tears, all with a hilariously tiny team!
[previewyoutube=fOl4J7PTz_c;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
We've talked about the game in the past and shared some screenshots and project updates here and there. We had an awesome and unique [url=https://ars.electronica.art/createyourworld/en/knight-light/]e-sports event in Austria[/url] many years ago, which gathered some attention, and later shared the game with a few very lucky closed beta players [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/451790/Forging_Glory/]via Steam[/url].

About two weeks ago, we were taken off guard by a surprising reality check. After much consternation, we decided to push up our schedule dramatically, and now pushing Forging Glory into the world like we never have before, with [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLhMN9mVmDltRzEsMT0KneCXKj-mweGfiO]near-daily devlogs[/url], [url=https://www.patreon.com/ZoopTEK]Patreon support[/url], and more! Forging Glory has been a journey already, but in many ways, we're just getting started.

[h2]What is Forging Glory?[/h2][previewyoutube=sLOPaIU6IZg;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
Right now, our working one-sentence summary is:

[i]Forging Glory is a physics-based looter brawler with limitless player customization; letting you experience the glory of brutal gladiatorial combat in a futuristic, virtual world.[/i]

As a gladiator in Forging Glory, you fight for glory, fame, and fortune. You are not only a warrior, but a celebrity.

[h2]Where are we in the development process?[/h2]
Our core features are in:
[list][*]Physics-based combat.[/*][*]Currently 7 unique weapons.[/*][*]Infinite dynamic campaigns, playable both alone or multiplayer, cooperatively (very popular) or competitively.[/*][*]6 game modes.[/*][*]Currently 70+ item modifiers to mix and match.[/*][*]Currently 300+ special abilities to choose from.[/*][*]Shop, to aid in finding items you seek (no microtransactions!).[/*][*]Smith, to aid in crafting ideal items.[/*][*]10 avatar skins (no microtransactions!).[/*][*]Basic "glory" scoring system, evaluating how entertaining you are, not just how lethal you are.[/*][*]Even [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/forging-glory/images/image-11#imagebox]an auto-GIF generator[/url], integrated into our [url=https://discord.gg/AMTKx9R]Discord[/url], for easy bragging to friends![/*][/list]
We’re currently getting ready to greatly expand our beta, testing and improving the entire gambit. We are confident in the above features, but we also know there is plenty of polish necessary before Forging Glory is ready for a final release. Given its looter shooter elements, we acknowledge it's absolutely critical to get player feedback! If you are interested in participating, [url=http://zooptek.com/forgingglory]sign-up for the beta[/url] to receive a free Steam key!

As we continue refining and polishing these areas, we’ll also be working on other components of the game that explore the Forging Glory universe. These will include expanded features like fandom (think virtual fans for your virtual gladiators), new traits (like headbutts!), and more. Even more reason to [url=http://zooptek.com/forgingglory]sign up for that beta[/url]!

As we get to this major milestone in our journey, we want to thank all those who have supported us so far. We really hope to make Forging Glory an amazing game with your help.
